title: Sound manifest (assets/sounds.yaml)
description: T3.7: sound files and their channel, the game events that play them and the music and ambient loop of each island, plus the music of the title screen, of a fight and of each boss. make validate also checks that files exist, that a vendor/ file has its CREDITS.md row, that every reference is a declared sound of the right channel, that islands exist in world/world.yaml and that bosses are monsters of data/monsters.

file.description: Path under assets/: sounds/... (our own, make sounds, lower case) or vendor/<pack>/... with the pack's own file names (letters, digits, spaces, . _ -; no segment starts with a dot).

events.description: Event name (client/src/audio/cues.ts) → sound id, or ids to pick one at random.

music.description: The keys of loops, plus what plays over them (client/src/audio/cues.ts musicFor): a boss in view, then a fight, then the zone. title plays outside the game.

title.description: The login, sign-up and character screens.

combat.description: While the player has a target or took a blow less than combat_hold_ms ago.

bosses.description: Monster id (data/monsters) → the loop that plays while one is in view, over a fight and the zone.
